description: RM-41: the four dm-verity backed erofs lower layers of the image. All four share one block device and one mount point, so before RM-41 added the root hash to a storage's identity this legitimate request was rejected as four duplicates.

RM-41: the same layer presented twice. The partition numbers still differ, so each storage matches a declaration and the count balances; only the root hash reveals that one declared layer was never presented.
RM-38: one layer presented without dm-verity. A single unverified lower layer is enough to control the container's filesystem, so the whole request is denied.
RM-38: a layer dropped. The declared layer count comes from the image manifest, so the host cannot silently shorten the stack.
RM-38: an extra layer injected. Content the image does not contain cannot be spliced into the container's rootfs.
RM-38: an unrecognised X-kata option added to a layer. Only the dm-verity parameters whose values are assigned at runtime may appear beyond what the policy declared.
RM-38: a declared option dropped from a layer.
RM-38: a layer redirected at another container's bundle.
RM-38: a malformed root hash. The value is not predictable at generation time, but its shape is.
RM-38: a layer presented as something other than erofs.
